messages:
priya: last mile check 1 tenant routing pilot planned for Wed. need final scope lock by EOD. Customer A asking for SAML + hard per-tenant quotas. whats realistic for MVP?
sam: perf note: embedding cache + per-tenant enforcement bumps p95 ~40ms. hard quotas add enforcement paths. can we ship UI-only quotas for MVP?
leila: ops POV: UI-only quotas + logging is low-risk. we can surface quota state and logs, enforce in v1.
jordan: CS update: Customer A says SAML is required for wide rollout but will accept pilot without if we provide a clear v1 timeline and migration steps.
mike: security: SAML touches KMS onboarding and private-deploy docs. higher risk for pilot timeline. recommend defer SAML to v1. will run tenant isolation threat model before pilot.
priya: proposed cutlist: include tenant routing + emb-cache (conservative TTL) + UI-only quotas. defer hard quota enforcement and SAML to v1. add migration notes for customers.
sam: 👍 on deferring hard quotas. emb-cache will ship with `--emb-cache-mode=conservative` and a runtime purge endpoint. add a kill-switch feature flag.
alex: we need concise acceptance criteria for sales/pilot contract.
leila: acceptance criteria draft: 1) tenant routing supports 50 active tenants concurrently; 2) p95 latency <= 300ms under pilot load; 3) quota UI visible and quota events logged; 4) audit logs enabled; 5) emb-cache fallback documented.
jordan: Customer A will sign pilot if we commit to SAML + hard quotas in v1 and provide migration plan. i'll put that into the contract.
sam: ops ask: run 24h canary with 10% traffic to dedicated pool and auto-fallback to hosted on errors/latency. command: `canary:start --route tenant-pilot --pct 10`.
priya: add canary + auto-fallback and a regression for tenant isolation to acceptance.
mike: will confirm threat model by EOD; must ensure no secrets cross tenants.
alex: timeline note: with these cuts Wed launch stands. if security or canary isn't green by EOD, slide to next Tue.
leila: ops checklist: smoke tests, canary runbook, dashboards, runbook updates. i'll own runbooks.
priya: final call: cutlist = defer SAML, defer hard quota enforcement, ship emb-cache conservative, UI-only quotas, add canary route + auto-fallback. final?
jordan: +1 CS.
sam: +1 eng.
mike: +1 sec (pending threat-model doc).
alex: i'll update roadmap and notify sales/solutions.
deploy-bot: reminder  changing rollout flags requires canary job. run: `canary:start --route tenant-pilot --percent 10`
